‘Ekti Desher Jono Gaan’ screened at Liberation War Museum
2022-07-23T20:18:44+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news-bytes/news/ekti-desher-jono-gaan-screened-liberation-war-museum-3077531

The documentary film "Ekti Desher Jono Gaan" based on 'The Concert for Bangladesh' was screened on Friday (July 22) evening at the Liberation War Museum.

The programme titled "The Concert for Bangladesh and Contribution of Foreign Friends in the Liberation War" was held to showcase the documentary on the occasion of the "The Concert for Bangladesh" 51st anniversary on August 1.

Authour and journalist, Shamim Al Amin, who created the documentary, gave the welcome speech while Foreign Minister, AK Abdul Momen, was the chief guest at the programme. Renowned actor and Member of Parliament, Asaduzzaman Noor, former Vice-Chancellor of Dhaka University and Chairman of Board of Trustees of National Museum Professor Dr. AAMS Arefin Siddique, among others were present at the event.

"There need to be more documentaries like this which will have a positive impact on the youth. He praised the foreign friends of Bangladesh, for playing an integral part in the study of liberation war and language movement," said the Foreign Minister.

"Shamim Al Amin should be rewarded by the state for this excellent work. He emphasized on showing more of the documentary in schools, colleges, and universities of the country including BTV and other televisions," mentioned AK Abdul Momen.
